page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz across 8 physical cores and 16 virtual CPUs on x86_64 architecture. It is provisioned with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance features dedicated CPU allocation, a 7 Gbps network bandwidth baseline, and operates on a KVM hypervisor. It contains no dedicated GPU hardware or bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent disk execution.

Performance evaluation highlights a notable contrast between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. Single-core performance metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the lower quartile range. However, multi-core workloads leverage all 16 threads effectively, delivering average benchmark results in Geekbench multi-core, PassMark CPU, and software compilation tasks. Memory throughput benchmarks show uncached read speeds of 69.78 GB/sec and write speeds of 51.98 GB/sec, supporting standard operational demands like Redis caching and static web delivery.

The ecs.g5ne.4xlarge provides steady, mid-tier multi-core computing capability suited for general enterprise applications, mid-sized database management, web server clusters, and lightweight build environments. The main hardware tradeoffs include constrained per-core single-thread throughput and the absence of bundled local storage. While larger LLM execution and high-frequency single-thread tasks are inefficient on this architecture, its balanced resource density offers predictable efficiency for scalable multi-threaded server workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on x86_64 architecture, featuring an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It offers 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores, paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The server lacks bundled local storage and discrete GPUs, relying on a 7 Gbps baseline network connection for external storage and data transfer. Benchmark results indicate modest single-thread processor performance alongside solid, mid-tier multi-core scaling in software compilation, web serving, and database management. Uncached memory read speeds reach 69.78 GB/sec, supporting moderate data throughput requirements. The primary engineering tradeoff involves lower single-core clock efficiency balanced against steady multi-threaded capacity. As a result, the ecs.g5ne.4xlarge is well fitted for general web application hosting, distributed caching, enterprise microservices, and multi-threaded background processing pipelines requiring balanced compute and RAM allocations without dedicated local disk attachments.
